trigger: A fresh Android Termux session is being prepared for bounded AgentSwitchboard repository work.

steps.action: Read AGENTS.md, .ai/agent-contract.json, .ai/harness/repository-family.registry.json, the root codebase map, canonical Android profile registry and this harness manifest before mutation.
steps.evidence: paths read and current profile/family authority recorded

steps.action: Record uname -a, HOME, PREFIX, command -v results for git tmux gh ssh curl jq python, and tool versions without exposing credentials. If python is missing, install the harness prerequisite with pkg install -y python, then prove command -v python and python --version.
Require a tmux session for repository work; verify detach, tmux ls, and reattach before credential or repository mutation.
Before diagnosing a missing command, reject literal bracketed-paste framing such as [200~ as an input-boundary failure and run command -v on the intended executable.

Before fetch or branch operations, prove the intended path is a Git checkout, read its origin, and require the AgentSwitchboard origin. If no usable clone exists, acquire the repository under Termux HOME first and rerun this gate.

For cross-repository work, read the family registry locally and run scripts/Get-RepositoryFamilyHarnessStatus.ps1 on a PowerShell-capable environment. If PowerShell is unavailable on Termux, record that family-level probe as unavailable and do not claim cross-repository readiness from local inspection alone.
steps.evidence: family status report or explicit unavailable proof boundary

steps.action: Name repository, branch, lane, owned scope, forbidden scope and one writer before changes.
Only after verified-local-clone passes, fetch current origin/main and create or use a non-default isolated feature branch; never use force or destructive cleanup.
Run the portable Android harness contract test before broader work when the repository and Python prerequisite are available.

failurePolicy: Preserve the tmux session and evidence, classify the exact failed boundary, repair only the owned boundary, then rerun the failed step before proceeding.
proofCeiling: Intake, local-clone and environment readiness only; no credential, branch write, family-wide readiness, provider/model behavior or product-runtime success is implied.
